description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1 ne nje nga lokacionet me te kerkuara ne Tirane per facilitetet qe ofron. 
Apartmenti ndodhet ne rrugen Islam Alla (lidh rr.Kavajes me rr.Myslym Shyri). 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor. 
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin shperndares, 2 dhoma gjumi, sallon+kuzhine, nje tualet dhe nje verand. 
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in one of the most sought-after locations in Tirana for the facilities it offers. The apartment is located on Islam Alla Street (connects Kavajes Street with Myslym Shyri Street). The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the distribution corridor, 2 bedrooms, living room + kitchen, a toilet and a veranda. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us
